feats/residual-magic-2434.name: Residual Magic
feats/residual-magic-2434.effectSummary: Gain two tactical options. Enduring Potency: after casting a spell from your daily allotment, if next round you cast the same spell from a scroll or wand, treat the item casting as though it came from your own daily allotment for caster level, save DC, and other spell effects. feats/retributive-spell-2448.effectSummary: A retributive spell has no immediate effect. For the next 24 hours or until you prepare/ready spells again, when a melee attack damages you, you may release it on that attacker as an immediate action. You can have only one retributive spell active; casting another cancels the first, and preparing/readying spells makes it dissipate. It uses a slot one level higher.

feats/return-shot-2450.name: Return Shot
feats/return-shot-2450.effectSummary: Once per round before you have acted, when aware and not flat-footed and about to be hit by a normal ranged weapon, make Reflex DC 20 + the weapon's enhancement bonus to snatch it. You can free a hand by releasing a two-handed grip or dropping a shield. Snatching is free. If you also hold an appropriate ranged weapon, you can return suitable ammunition: loading a bow takes a move-equivalent action, a crossbow a standard action, and rethrowing a thrown weapon is free. The return attack bonus equals half the attacker's ranged attack bonus, rounded down, plus your full ranged attack bonus. Exceptional projectiles such as giant boulders or Melf's acid arrow cannot be caught.
